page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg8i.32xlarge is an x86_64 server instance belonging to the High Clock Speed family. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 6462C processors clocked at 3.3 GHz, paired with 512.0 GB of system memory to maintain a balanced 4.0 GB per core allocation. The instance runs under the KVM hypervisor without local disk storage or hardware GPU accelerators.

Network performance is a primary feature of this configuration, offering a baseline network bandwidth of 100 Gbps, though it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Because persistent local block storage is absent, all storage operations require external network-attached block volumes. In terms of cost efficiency, the configuration consolidates massive core density and elevated clock frequencies within a single node, maximizing single-thread and multi-thread performance efficiency while offloading disk persistence to remote storage.

Given its high-frequency Intel cores, dedicated CPU allocation, extensive memory footprint, and 100 Gbps network interface, ecs.hfg8i.32xlarge is matched to computationally intensive distributed processing, large-scale software compilation and CI/CD pipelines, in-memory data analytics, and high-throughput enterprise application serving.

From a resource efficiency standpoint, the instance bundles significant multi-core throughput and high clock frequencies into a single host footprint, optimizing compute-bound parallelized execution. It is suited for compute-intensive workloads, multi-threaded batch processing, in-memory data structures, distributed simulations, and high-concurrency enterprise services requiring fast processing cycles and extensive network throughput.
